title: The Outcasts of Poker Flat
focus: moral worth found among those society rejects

teacherSummary.text: In 1850, a vigilance committee in the mining camp of Poker Flat expels gambler John Oakhurst, 'The Duchess', Mother Shipton and drunken Uncle Billy. On the trail they meet innocent young Tom Simson and his fiancée Piney. Snowed in, Uncle Billy steals the mules. Mother Shipton starves herself to save food for Piney; Tom goes for help. Oakhurst shoots himself under a pine; the Duchess and Piney die in each other's arms.
